events.title: Active Approach to Osteoarthritis
events.time: 7:30 PM · RISE, 245 Kimberly Road, Winkler, MB
events.description: Learn how movement, strength, nutrition, and lifestyle can help you manage osteoarthritis, reduce symptoms, and stay active. Join us for a FREE practical workshop on managing osteoarthritis and staying active as you age, with a focus on knee and hip osteoarthritis. We’ll break down what osteoarthritis is, what it means for your joints, and how movement and strength can play an important role in managing symptoms and improving function. You’ll also learn how nutrition and everyday lifestyle habits can support joint health and help you continue doing the activities you enjoy. The workshop will combine education with practical strategies and exercises you can apply both inside and outside the gym. *MUST Pre-Register, use the link below.

events.title: Movie Magic: Greatest Film Themes for Violin & Piano
events.time: 2:00 PM · Manitou Opera House, 325 Main Street, Manitou, MB
events.description: Experience the music behind some of cinema's greatest moments — live at the Manitou Opera House! The magic of the movies is coming to the Manitou Opera House! Join Winnipeg-based violinist Amir Bissen and pianist Fan-En Chiang for an intimate live concert featuring some of the most unforgettable music from the world of film. From the suspense of Jaws and the adventure of Jurassic Park to the romance of The Godfather, the excitement of James Bond and Star Wars, and the magic of Harry Potter, Movie Magic brings beloved film themes to life in specially curated arrangements for violin and piano. Rather than simply recreating the original orchestral scores, Bissen and Chiang bring their own expressive interpretations to these familiar melodies. Their intimate arrangements offer audiences a fresh and captivating way to experience music that has become woven into popular culture. Whether you're a longtime classical music enthusiast, a devoted movie fan, or simply looking for an entertaining afternoon of live music, Movie Magic promises an experience for audiences of all ages. Sunday, October 4, 2026 2:00 PM Doors open at 1:00 PM Manitou Opera House — Manitou, Manitoba What You'll Hear Travel through some of Hollywood's most memorable musical moments, featuring themes from iconic films and franchises including: Jaws Jurassic Park The Godfather James Bond Star Wars Harry Potter …and more! Hear these familiar themes in a completely new way as they're transformed for violin and piano and performed live in the intimate setting of the historic Manitou Opera House. Meet the Performers Amir Bissen — Violin Winnipeg-based violinist Amir Bissen brings extensive international performing experience to the stage. Bissen began his musical career at an early age, studying at the Purcell School of Music and Royal College of Music in England. His performing career has taken him throughout Europe and includes a Royal Festival Hall debut with the Philharmonia Orchestra. He has also pursued advanced studies with renowned violin pedagogue Zakhar Bron, bringing a wealth of musical experience and artistry to his performances. Fan-En Chiang — Piano Fan-En Chiang is an award-winning Taiwanese-Canadian pianist and composer based in Winnipeg. His performances have included appearances with the Winnipeg Symphony Orchestra, and his musical interests extend beyond the classical repertoire to include film music and video-game soundtracks. Together, Bissen and Chiang are developing themed recital programs that bring familiar and much-loved music to audiences while showcasing the artistry, energy and intimacy of live classical performance. Experience Movie Music Like Never Before You've heard these melodies in movie theatres. Now hear them live, up close and reimagined for violin and piano. Come relive the suspense, adventure, romance and magic of some of cinema's greatest stories through the music that helped make them unforgettable. Movie Magic: Greatest Film Themes for Violin & Piano is an afternoon for movie lovers, music lovers and anyone who enjoys a great live performance.
